# mailtrap_sandbox (Resource)

Manages a Mailtrap sandbox (testing inbox) inside a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mailtrap_project" "example" {
  name = "My Project"
}

resource "mailtrap_sandbox" "example" {
  project_id = mailtrap_project.example.id
  name       = "Staging"
}

# SMTP credentials for the sandbox.
output "smtp_username" {
  value     = mailtrap_sandbox.example.username
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the sandbox.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project the sandbox belongs to. Changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `email_username` (String) Username part of the sandbox's email address.

### Read-Only

- `api_domain` (String) API domain of the sandbox.
- `domain` (String) SMTP domain of the sandbox.
- `email_domain` (String) Domain of the sandbox's email address.
- `email_username_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the sandbox's email address is enabled.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the sandbox.
- `max_message_size` (Number) Maximum accepted message size in bytes.
- `max_size` (Number) Maximum number of messages the sandbox retains.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP/POP3 password of the sandbox.
- `pop3_domain` (String) POP3 domain of the sandbox.
- `pop3_ports` (List of Number) POP3 ports the sandbox listens on.
- `smtp_ports` (List of Number) SMTP ports the sandbox listens on.
- `status` (String) Status of the sandbox.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) SMTP/POP3 username of the sandbox.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a sandbox by its numeric ID.
terraform import mailtrap_sandbox.example 12345
```
